criteria.text: The session-count floor and exercised-tools evidence must count the same session population, including agentKind-attributed and delegated-child sessions.
Profile requirement matching is case-insensitive and expands server-id aliases, underscore/hyphen variants, and names without a -mcp/_mcp suffix.
Granted skill bodies are checked case-insensitively and an explicit per-tool tools-map grant is treated as intentional.
